title: Public Tender Monitor input
description: Search open public procurement notices from official free APIs and feeds.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Official sources to query. A source that fails is logged and skipped.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Case-insensitive substring match against the title or description. A notice matches if any keyword hits. Leave empty to disable keyword filtering.

cpvCodes.title: CPV or category codes
cpvCodes.description: CPV codes for TED and the UK sources (prefix match). Other sources match these strings against the published category text or codes.

countries.title: Countries
countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 codes. TED filters on buyer country. Leave empty to keep every country.

openOnly.title: Open notices only
openOnly.description: Drop notices whose deadline is already past. Notices with no published deadline are kept.

publishedWithinDays.title: Published within days
publishedWithinDays.description: Keep notices published on or after this many days ago. Notices with no published date are dropped.

maxItems.title: Maximum items
maxItems.description: Global cap on dataset items. Each source is also capped at this number before the results are interleaved.

samGovApiKey.title: SAM.gov API key
samGovApiKey.description: Optional public API key from SAM.gov. Used only when sam_gov is selected. If sam_gov is selected and this is empty, that source is skipped with a warning.
